24.04.2026 WPSB No. 234 of 2026
Bharat Singh Bhandari ------Petitioner
 Versus
The State of Uttarakhand and others. -Respondents
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Ms. Ketki Chhaya Chaudhary, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. Sri B.S. Parihar, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel 
with Sri S.M.S. Mehta, learned Brief Holder for the State of 
Uttarakhand. 
3. The submission of the petitioner is that the impugned order 
dated 05.05.2025, whereby approval has been granted for recovery of 
a sum of Rs. 2,80,608/- from the gratuity of the petitioner, has been 
passed without any notice or opportunity of hearing to him. Further 
contention is that the first promotional pay-scale was rightly granted 
to the petitioner since 11.02.2001 after counting his ad-hoc services, 
but the impugned order has been passed without taking into 
consideration the ad-hoc services and, accordingly, the conclusion,
arrived at by the respondents that the first promotional pay-scale was 
wrongly granted since 11.02.2001, is wholly erroneous. 
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner places reliance on the 
judgment of the Hon’ble Supreme Court in State of Punjab & 
others vs. Rafiq Masih reported in (2014) 8 SCC 883. 
5. The matter requires consideration. 
6. Let counter-affidavit(s) be field by the respondents within 
three weeks. 
7. The petitioner will have a week thereafter to file rejoinder￾affidavit.  8. List after expiry of four weeks. 
9. Meanwhile, there shall be stay of the effect and operation of 
the order dated 05.05.2025, and any amount, deducted by the 
respondents from the gratuity of the petitioner, shall be refunded to 
the petitioner after obtaining adequate security, other than bank and 
cash guarantee.
 
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
 24.04.2026 24.04.2026
Rathour

28.09.2026 UKHC010065222026
WPSB/234/2026
Bharat Singh Bhandari --Petitioner
 Versus
The State Of Uttarakhand --Respondent
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Ms. Ketki Chaudhary, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. S.M.S. Mehta, learned Brief Holder for the State 
of Uttarakhand. 
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner states that the 
petitioner has not been refunded the gratuity amount, as 
was directed by this Court vide order dated 24.04.2026.
4. Learned State Counsel has placed on record the 
instructions received from the Director, Agriculture, 
according to which proposal was sent by the Directorate to 
the Government for allocating adequate budget. However, 
the budget has not been allocated so far. 
5. Learned State Counsel is granted time to obtain 
instructions in this regard. 
6. Learned State Counsel further states that all efforts 
would be made for making payment within three weeks. 
Accordingly, his statement is recorded. 
7. Let necessary allocation of budget be done within 
three weeks and the gratuity amount be refunded to the 
petitioner. 
8. List after three weeks. 
9. The petitioner may file rejoinder affidavit in the 
meantime. 
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.) 
 28.09.2026 28.09.2026
Rahul
